source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Failure of power supply
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Production & Assembly & Transport & Checkout systems
description: Disruption or failure of the satellite's power supply, resulting in satellite becoming unresponsive due to a shut down. This can happen several times as a result of, for example, faulty batteries, damage to, or malfunction of other power sources, such as solar panels, are also possible.
